description: Scrape BBC Good Food recipes, ingredients, method steps, and UK nutrition panels without cookies or an API key.

category.description: Collection for mode=byCategory. Use a slug like 'pasta-recipes', 'vegan-recipes', 'baking-recipes', 'dessert-recipes', or paste a full https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/collection/... URL. Leave empty to browse all recipes.
category.title: Collection Slug or URL

cuisine.description: Optional cuisine filter; comma-separate several values, e.g. 'italian,mediterranean'. Common values: italian, british, indian, asian, chinese, french, mexican, thai, mediterranean, american, spanish, greek, middle-eastern, japanese, caribbean, moroccan, turkish, vietnamese.
cuisine.title: Cuisine

diets.description: Keep recipes carrying every selected dietary tag. Empty array = no diet filter.
diets.title: Dietary Filters

difficulty.description: Keep only recipes at this skill level.
difficulty.title: Difficulty

maxCalories.description: Keep recipes at or below this calories-per-serving value.
maxCalories.title: Max Calories (kcal)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of recipe records to return.
maxItems.title: Max Recipes

maxTotalTimeMinutes.description: Keep recipes whose published total time is at most this many minutes.
maxTotalTimeMinutes.title: Max Total Time (minutes)

mealTypes.description: Keep recipes matching at least one selected meal type. Empty array = no meal filter.
mealTypes.title: Meal Types

minRating.description: Keep recipes rated at or above this community rating (1.0-5.0).
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

minServings.description: Keep recipes whose published yield is at least this many servings.
minServings.title: Minimum Servings

mode.description: How to find recipes. Search uses BBC Good Food's own search. Browse all walks the full index with the same filters. Collection takes a slug or collection URL. Recipe URLs fetches exact pages. Sitemap walks newest sitemap files first.
mode.title: Mode

query.description: Keyword for mode=search (e.g. 'chicken curry', 'vegan cake'). Leave empty to browse every recipe.
query.title: Search Query

sortBy.description: Result order for search and all-recipes modes; collection and URL modes sort the collected rows.
sortBy.title: Sort By

startUrls.description: Recipe pages for mode=byUrl. Accepts https://www.bbcgoodfood.com/recipes/... and /premium/... links.
startUrls.title: Recipe URLs

title: BBC Good Food Recipe Scraper Input
